about: The item score's stat weights, written by Tools/build/build_weights.py: 'max' is the set at level 60, 'leveling' the set below it (none for the tanks, who use 'max'). Each spec's unit is a point of the stat named in 'unit'.

DRUID:Balance.notes: Vengeance lifts Wrath's and Starfire's crits.

DRUID:FeralBear.notes: Bears cannot parry or block; armor counts several times over in bear form.

DRUID:FeralCat.notes: In cat form a weapon's DPS does nothing: only its stats and feral attack power count.

HUNTER:BeastMastery.notes: Aimed and Multi-Shot add to the bow's damage; the pet does much of the work.

MAGE:Arcane.notes: Arcane Meditation keeps some Spirit regen while casting.

PALADIN:Holy.notes: Illumination refunds the mana of a healing crit: crit and Intellect count double.

PALADIN:Protection.notes: Holy Shield and Consecration make spell damage threat.

PALADIN:Retribution.notes: A slow two-hander: Seal of Command and Crusader Strike hit with it.

PRIEST:Discipline.notes: Mental Strength makes Intellect worth more.

PRIEST:Holy.notes: Spirit keeps the mana coming between pulls; Holy Fire and Smite while leveling.

PRIEST:Shadow.notes: Mind Flay and Shadow Word: Pain never crit; Spirit Tap makes Spirit the leveling regen.

ROGUE:Assassination.notes: Lethality and Relentless Strikes lift crit; daggers.

ROGUE:Combat.notes: Sinister Strike hits with the weapon; two weapons swing white.

SHAMAN:Enhancement.notes: Windfury and Stormstrike hit with the weapon; Flurry lifts crit.

SHAMAN:EnhancementTank.notes: Turtle WoW's shaman tank: shield, shocks for threat.

SHAMAN:Restoration.notes: Mana per 5 over Spirit: shamans regenerate little from Spirit.

WARLOCK:Affliction.notes: Damage over time never crits; Life Tap turns health into mana and Drain Life keeps you up, so Stamina and Spirit (health regen) carry you while leveling.

WARLOCK:Demonology.notes: Demonic Embrace and the pet: Stamina is worth more.

WARLOCK:Destruction.notes: Ruin doubles a crit; Shadow Bolt is the main spell, Immolate and Conflagrate the fire.

WARRIOR:Arms.notes: Mortal Strike, Slam and Whirlwind hit with the weapon; Impale and Deep Wounds lift crit.

WARRIOR:Fury.notes: Two weapons: each hand's DPS counts for that hand; Flurry lifts crit; more white swings miss.

WARRIOR:Protection.notes: Stamina, Defense and avoidance at every level, as a tank levels in a group.
